i can never seem to find lots of good veggie side dish recipes. Just wanted to know how you guys prepare your fresh or frozen veggies? I could use canned, too, but prefer fresh or frozen.

Here is mine, to get things started. this is off the top of my head, so please excuse formatting.

Simple Cabbage Recipe

1 head cabbage

1-2 TBSP bacon grease, or other oil/fat if you have no bacon grease. Bacon grease is best though.

salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes

water

DIRECTIONS

core, then quarter the head of cabbage, and chop into roughly 1 inch pieces/chunks. they should cook apart as you cook the cabbage. Throw the cabbage into a big ass frying pan, and add about 1/2 inch of water.

go ahead and throw in the S&P, as well as red pepper flakes. I probably do about a half TSP of flakes, but you can adjust to your spiciness preferences.

*at any point in time, throw the bacon grease in there. it will help later when frying, and also flavor the cabbage.

cover pan, and let the cabbage steam at medium or medium-high or whatever until fork tender.

once fork tender, make sure you have bacon grease in there by the next step.

remove lid, and let water evaporate. This is the step where you probably want to stir it or something, to avoid burning.

Once water evaporates, stir around and fry in bacon grease until the edges are just barely brown. Dat sweet malliard reaction tho.

Now eat.
